text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ligne Droite— A ball for the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume invite the partners they ran 
through this past year with to a dance, 
spending an irreplaceable time together.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I wanna practice before the 
Droits. Trainer, lend me a hand for a bit, 
will ya?
choice_data_list: I'm not an Umamusume, is that okay?
I'm not an Umamusume, but is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I told you, it's fine. If we're practicing 
a pair dance, it's better with someone 
whose schedule aligns easily, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We spend plenty of time together. That 
means plenty of chances to practice in 
between, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Here we go, one, two, three—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, if you put your foot there, 
you're gonna get stepped on by me, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
Narrator
text_block_list.text: —At this rate, things are going to be bad.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from being Tap Dance City's training 
partner, I'm just holding her back. At the 
very least, I have to become capable of 
keeping up...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, perfect! You managed to dance the 
whole thing through!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nice, practice is really paying off. Looks 
like this is going to be a special dance 
time.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Gratitude, admiration, trust, things I 
lack myself. When you run, you naturally 
develop them— those special feelings for a 
special someone.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then again, opportunities to openly talk 
about that don't come around very often, 
do they?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's why we use the droit as an excuse. 
Put everything into the dance and throw it 
at your partner.
choice_data_list:
It must be wonderful to have someone you 
care about that much.

It must be wonderful to have someone you 
care about that much.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's truly fate! Well then, back to 
practice. I want us to have an 
exceptionally wonderful time on that day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our time sparring flew by in the 
blink of an eye—and the day of the Droit 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How about that? Pretty slick, right? Come 
on, hit me with a killer compliment!
choice_data_list: It looks great on you! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I'm honored by your compliment. I 
dressed up especially for today, after 
all.
choice_data_list: Then you'd better go have a blast!

Then you'll have to go have as much fun as 
you can!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Come on, don't be so cold.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: You and I are over this way!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are, Tap! Judging by that 
look, things must've gone well.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just as you see! Come on, make some 
room! Our navigator has returned to base!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I say it? I wanted to share a 
"special dance time" with you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I gave it some serious thought, you know? 
Because I just really wanted to pass it on 
to you. These feelings, precious as 
treasure, born as I ran—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—To none other than your one and only 
partner, right?
choice_data_list:
...Was this your intention from the 
start...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, something was off. If 
it was just dance practice, she could do 
it with her friends. Besides, she was 
already a skilled dancer to begin with—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, all that practice was 
designed so I could respond without 
hesitation...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, quit spacing out! Or do you wanna 
get your foot stepped on by me again?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to believe I'm not the only one 
who wants to dance together, though?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about! Now 
then—may I have your hand, Navigator?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Did you like the surprise?
choice_data_list:
I was so startled I thought my heart would 
jump out of my chest.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's not good! I can't have you 
stopping here.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna stay on this ship with me, 
chasing our dreams together forever! And 
we're gonna spend all our time laughing, 
got it?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, haha! Hey now, your steps are all 
over the place! That's not like you, our 
meticulous Navigator!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wait—are you drunk? Well, with a feast 
this grand, I can't blame you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ~♪ ~~♪ Sounds great, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Might've had a decent shot in Droite too, 
huh? Should we just jump in right now?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, roger that. I'll show off my treasure 
another time.
